description: The bar chart titled “Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task (n=2)” illustrates accuracy values for multiple model variants across five attribute types. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, shown left to right as “Qwen2.5-7b-1M,” “Internlm3-8b,” a third model label that is visually obscured by a gray block, and “Qwen2.5-7b.” The vertical axis is a numeric accuracy scale (linear) with tick marks at regular intervals (approximately every 20 units), spanning from 0 up to just under 100. Each model group contains five adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: city (teal/green), hobby (orange), university (blue), major (pink), and birthdate (light green). For “Qwen2.5-7b-1M,” the bars are all high, with approximate values around city ~92, hobby ~90, university ~87, major ~95, and birthdate ~90. For “Internlm3-8b,” the bars are mid-to-high with city ~71, hobby ~76, university ~54, major ~65, and birthdate ~89. For the obscured third model, the visible bars indicate city ~68, hobby ~78, university ~61, major ~29, and birthdate ~84. For “Qwen2.5-7b,” all bars are near the bottom of the axis, with city ~3, hobby ~4, university ~2, major ~4, and birthdate ~16. The bars are grouped by model (side-by-side within each model) rather than stacked, there is no explicit sorting indicated beyond the left-to-right model order, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the standard color coding and the legend.
